title: Subdistricts

blocks.html: In order to carry out the purposes and provisions of this Chapter, six subdistricts are established within the Special Long Island City Mixed Use District, as follows:
blocks.plainText: In order to carry out the purposes and provisions of this Chapter, six subdistricts are established within the Special Long Island City Mixed Use District, as follows:

blocks.html: Court Square Subdistrict, as set forth in Section 117-40, inclusive;
blocks.plainText: Court Square Subdistrict, as set forth in Section 117-40, inclusive;

blocks.html: Dutch Kills Subdistrict, as set forth in Section 117-60, inclusive;
blocks.plainText: Dutch Kills Subdistrict, as set forth in Section 117-60, inclusive;

blocks.html: Hunters Point Subdistrict, as set forth in Section 117-10, inclusive;
blocks.plainText: Hunters Point Subdistrict, as set forth in Section 117-10, inclusive;

blocks.html: Northern Hunters Point Waterfront Subdistrict, as set forth in Section 117-30, inclusive;
blocks.plainText: Northern Hunters Point Waterfront Subdistrict, as set forth in Section 117-30, inclusive;

blocks.html: Queens Plaza Subdistrict, as set forth in Section 117-50, inclusive; and
blocks.plainText: Queens Plaza Subdistrict, as set forth in Section 117-50, inclusive; and

blocks.html: Queens Plaza West Subdistrict, as set forth in Section 117-20, inclusive.
blocks.plainText: Queens Plaza West Subdistrict, as set forth in Section 117-20, inclusive.

blocks.html: In each of these subdistricts, certain special regulations apply which do not apply within the remainder of the Special Long Island City Mixed Use District. The subdistricts are outlined on Map 1 in Appendix A of this Chapter.
